changes.title: Party witch art first
items: Party witches show up straight away at home, instead of after the rest of the forest has been drawn

changes.title: Beacons on ley
items: A runestone's column of light now only appears when the ley line reaches it, shooting up with a flare
The rings of magic symbols round the runestones are gone: the ley line, its pulse and the beacons show what's coming

changes.title: Circular map
items: The map is round now: about 196 areas in a circle round home, then a ring of quiet forest with nothing to do in it before the edge
Flying out to the edge slows you gently and drifts you back in, instead of a hard wall (?shape=square brings back the old square map)
